historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission engaged the architect Leonard S. Mosias to design a tennis clubhouse and handball courts in Golden Gate Park and to rehabilitate the bowling green clubhouse.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build the new tennis clubhouse in Golden Gate Park to Clovis Construction Co. at $77,000.

At the request of the city's tennis players, the Recreation and Park Commission named the new tennis clubhouse in Golden Gate Park the William M. Johnston Memorial Clubhouse, for "Little Bill" Johnston, the world tennis champion.
Tennis courts and a tennis club house were built.
